seams.scoring_field: CLWR verdict_and_disposition.disposition (NOT the raw seam-atom status)

seams.detection_check: atom s4_seam (rule seam_f4_support): T iff none of the seven S1-resolved tests regressed in R1 (so F4 per B8-4 is unsupported)
seams.scoring_field: CLWR verdict_and_disposition.disposition (NOT the raw seam-atom status)

seams.detection_check: atom s5_seam (rule seam_schema_drift): T iff the two manifests bind members under different field names

seams.scoring_field: CLWR verdict_and_disposition.disposition (NOT the raw seam-atom status)
